denominator = np.sum((z - z_mean)**2)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load and prepare data
crime_df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
adjacency_df = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)
crime_df['crime_change'] = crime_df['first_half_2014_value'] - crime_df['second_half_2013_value']

# Create mapping and weight matrix
boroughs = crime_df['borough'].values
n = len(boroughs)
borough_to_idx = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(boroughs)}

# Build symmetric binary weight matrix
W = np.zeros((n, n))
for _, row in adjacency_df.iterrows():
    try:
        i = borough_to_idx[row['borough']]
        j = borough_to_idx[row['neighbor']]
        W[i,j] = 1
        W[j,i] = 1
    except KeyError:
        continue

# Verify matrix properties
print(f"Matrix symmetry check: {np.allclose(W, W.T)}")
print(f"Matrix connectivity: {np.sum(W.sum(axis=1) > 0)}/{n} connected boroughs")

# Standardize matrix using alternative approach
row_sums = W.sum(axis=1)
W_std = W / row_sums[:, np.newaxis] if np.all(row_sums > 0) else W / (row_sums[:, np.newaxis] + 1e-10)

# Calculate Moran's I with stability checks
z = crime_df['crime_change'].values
z_mean = z.mean()
z_std = z.std()
if z_std < 1e-10:
    print("Warning: Near-zero standard deviation in crime changes")
    I = np.nan
else:
    S0 = np.sum(W_std)
    S1 = 0.5 * np.sum((W_std + W_std.T)**2)
    S2 = np.sum((W_std.sum(axis=0) + W_std.sum(axis=1))**2)
    
    z_norm = (z - z_mean) / z_std
    I = np.sum(W_std * z_norm[:, np.newaxis] * z_norm) / S0

# Permutation test
if not np.isnan(I):
    np.random.seed(42)
    n_permutations = 500
    permuted_Is = np.zeros(n_permutations)
    for i in range(n_permutations):
        z_perm = np.random.permutation(z)
        z_perm_norm = (z_perm - z_perm.mean()) / z_perm.std()
        permuted_Is[i] = np.sum(W_std * z_perm_norm[:, np.newaxis] * z_perm_norm) / S0
    p_value = (np.sum(permuted_Is >= I) + 1) / (n_permutations + 1)
else:
    p_value = np.nan

print(f"\nFinal Results:")
print(f"Moran's I: {I}")
print(f"p-value: {p_value}")
print(f"Data variance: {z.var()}")
print(f"Matrix density: {np.sum(W > 0)/(n*n):.4f}")
